page: Microsoft Azure L48aos_v5 is a member of the Laosv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of the L48aos_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, which includes 34,557 GB of NVMe SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput and low-latency disk operations. It does not include integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of both memory and local NVMe SSD storage, this server type is structured for data-intensive workloads. The hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring massive local scratch space or high-speed caching alongside significant memory capacity. It is suited for large-scale databases, big data analytics, transactional processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications that benefit from direct, high-capacity local storage.
